risk_description: Transmission joints and/or related replacement joints (such as for the lower suspension arm, battery terminal) may not be properly tightened, which could cause the joints to loosen over time. This could cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
